text:
sophie: Heads-up — around 09:42 UTC we started seeing 403s from the SSO proxy for ~5% of logins, only for users coming through the corporate VPN.

mike_r: Saw that too. SCIM provisioning looks fine, user objects present. The failures are coming from the sso-proxy -> idp mTLS request path.

anita: Any rollout/rotations around that time? KMS key rotate or cert refresh?

sophie: KMS rotated master key at 09:40 for creds-service, but we only intended to rotate data keys. Not sure if that touched the proxy cert store.

diego: Looking at proxy logs:

```
2026-03-18T09:42:11Z sso-proxy[auth] WARN client_cert_verify failed: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
2026-03-18T09:42:11Z sso-proxy[auth] INFO upstream-request status=403 idp=okta-corp user=jdoe vpn=true
```

oncall-sre: @sophie can you confirm whether the proxy uses KMS for cert decryption or the host cert store? I recall we moved client certs to KMS-wrapped secrets last quarter. :thinking_face:

sophie: Confirmed: sso-proxy loads client certs from secrets-service which decrypts with KMS. The secret data is a pkcs12 protected with a passphrase that lives in KMS-wrapped JSON.

mike_r: If KMS master changed, secrets-service should have re-encrypted fine. But I wonder if there was a race where proxy restarted while secrets-service was in a transient state and got an incomplete cert blob — corrupted pkcs12 -> client will present malformed cert and idp rejects.

anita: Can you grep for "pkcs12: invalid" or similar in secrets-service and proxy logs?

diego: Found a handful of records right at 09:40:

```
2026-03-18T09:40:03Z secrets-service ERROR decrypt: crypto: message authentication failed (key=projects/redwood/keys/rotation-2026)
2026-03-18T09:40:04Z secrets-service INFO retrying decrypt
2026-03-18T09:40:07Z secrets-service INFO decrypt ok, returning secret id=ssoproxy-client-01
```

sophie: So short window of failed decrypts followed by success. If sso-proxy fetched during the window it might have cached a bad blob. That could explain the ~5% retry rate (only proxies behind certain LB nodes restarted).

oncall-sre: Can we validate what cert the proxy is presenting upstream for recent failing sessions? Any tcpdump?

mike_r: Grabbed a dump from one affected node. The client cert CN shows up but the signature algorithm is unusual: ecdsa-with-SHA1. IdP policy blocks sha1-based signatures now.

anita: That suggests either the pkcs12 was corrupted and OpenSSL chose a fallback key, or a wrong keyfile was served. Does secrets-service keep prior versions?

sophie: Yes, secrets-service stores versions. I pulled v3 (pre-rotate) and v4 (rotate) and compared. v4's pem looks truncated — base64 padding missing. v3 is fine.

diego: Hypothesis: during KMS rotate we ran a two-step rewrap and an incomplete write landed in the secret store for a brief moment. Proxies that fetched then used the truncated pem -> OpenSSL parsed it to a legacy key -> IDP rejected (sha1).

oncall-sre: Short-term mitigation: roll sso-proxy nodes to force them to re-fetch secrets (post-rotate v4 fixed) and clear any transient caches. Also add a check at startup to validate cert signature alg.

anita: Agreed. I'm queueing a pod restart for the 6 affected nodes in the corp-vpn pool.

sophie: Doing a manual check before restart: validating pem from secrets-service v4 returns OK. Will restart node-07 and confirm login success.

(2m later)
diego: node-07 restart done, login worked for test user via vpn. No 403 in logs.

oncall-sre: Nice. Next actions?

mike_r: Action items:
- secrets-team: add atomic write + checksum validation when writing rewrapped secrets to avoid truncated version writes.
- sso-proxy: on startup validate certs and fail fast if signature algo disallowed (prevent presenting weak keys).
- infra: add short-lived alert when secrets-service decrypt error rate > 1/min during rotation windows.

anita: Also add a one-off audit: list all services that pulled ssoproxy-client-01 between 09:39-09:42 and force refresh. I can run that.

sophie: I filed a post-incident ticket #SEC-2026-121 with the dumps and timeline. Will follow up with a changelog for the secrets rewrap process. :memo:

oncall-sre: If nothing else, I'll watch for regressions through 11:00 UTC. Ping here if you see new 403 spikes.

deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline restarted for sso-proxy nodes: run id 2026-03-18T09:47:22Z. :rocket:

sophie: thanks all :pray:

mike_r: leaving note to docs: update runbook "sso-proxy cert rotation" with KMS rewrap caveat and recovery steps.

anita: I'll attach the relevant logs to SEC-2026-121 and mark for vuln triage to see if IDP policy should be relaxed temporarily (likely no).

sophie: closing thread for now, will reopen if we see any other affected pools.
